fato_historico: 1780: James Cook's ship HMS Resolution returns to England (Cook having been killed on Hawaii during the voyage).
energia_do_dia: Today brings a grounding energy that encourages you to honor your roots. Much like a long-traveled ship returning to calm waters after vast explorations, you may feel it is a good time to anchor your heart in familiar comforts. Consider how your personal growth has transformed your inner landscape while you remained true to your Taurus spirit.
frase_do_dia: Every great journey eventually guides us back to the peace within our own hearts.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your patient and long-term hard work.
conselho: Nurture your physical space and enjoy the quiet solace of your beautiful home.
